require "thinkthen"

# the one line that gives the refund deadline
policy = ["Returns need the original receipt.",
    "Refunds are issued within 30 days of purchase.",
    "Shipping is free on orders over $50."]
ask = "Which line gives the refund deadline?"
puts ThinkThen.find(ask, policy).unit

# praise, a bug, and a double charge in one message
labels = ["praise", "bug", "billing"]
p ThinkThen.tag("Which labels fit this message?",
    "Love it, but export crashes and I was billed twice.",
    labels:)

printed.output:
Refunds are issued within 30 days of purchase.
["praise", "bug", "billing"]
printed.see: The double charge is tagged billing.
